/**
 * The words the pane draws, by language. A line French leaves out is drawn
 * in English.
 *
 * @module say
 */

export const EN = {
  title: '⌖ Control tower',
  sessions: (n: number) => (n === 1 ? '1 session' : `${n} sessions`),
  you: ' (you)',
  thinking: 'thinking',
  idle: 'idle',
  awaitsAnswer: 'awaits an answer',
  alone: 'No other session yet: one appears once radar runs in it, under this config folder or one extraConfigDirs names.',
  terminalOnly: 'The animated radar draws in the terminal only.',
  command: 'Opens the control tower: your sessions on a radar; available: takes tasks from a conductor, or stops; conductor: hands the tasks of a checklist to the sessions that take them',
  opened: 'Control tower opened.',
  join: '⛑ Take tasks',
  leave: '⛑ Stop taking tasks',
  nowAvailable: '⛑ This session takes tasks from a conductor now; /radar available again to stop.',
  nowUnavailable: 'This session takes no more tasks from a conductor.',
  takesTasks: 'Takes tasks from a conductor',
  stop: 'Stop',
  handedBy: (from: string) => (from ? `handed by ${from}` : 'handed by a conductor'),
}

export type Texts = typeof EN

export const FR: Partial<Texts> = {
  title: '⌖ Tour de contrôle',
  you: ' (vous)',
  thinking: 'réfléchit',
  idle: 'inactive',
  awaitsAnswer: 'attend une réponse',
  alone: 'Aucune autre session : une session apparaît dès que radar y tourne, sous ce dossier de config ou un de ceux que nomme extraConfigDirs.',
  terminalOnly: 'Le radar animé ne se dessine que dans le terminal.',
  command: 'Ouvre la tour de contrôle : vos sessions sur un radar ; available : accepte les tâches d’un chef de chantier, ou arrête ; conductor : confie les tâches d’une liste aux sessions qui en acceptent',
  opened: 'Tour de contrôle ouverte.',
  join: '⛑ Accepter des tâches',
  leave: '⛑ Ne plus accepter de tâches',
  nowAvailable: '⛑ Cette session accepte désormais les tâches d’un chef de chantier ; /radar available à nouveau pour arrêter.',
  nowUnavailable: 'Cette session n’accepte plus de tâches d’un chef de chantier.',
  takesTasks: 'Accepte des tâches d’un chef de chantier',
  stop: 'Se retirer',
  handedBy: from => (from ? `confiée par ${from}` : 'confiée par un chef de chantier'),
}

// The conductor's words: its pane, its band rows and its toasts.

export const CONDUCTOR_EN = {
  title: '⛑ Conductor',
  tasks: (n: number) => (n === 1 ? '1 task' : `${n} tasks`),
  sessions: (n: number) => (n === 1 ? '1 session' : `${n} sessions`),
  auto: 'auto',
  manual: 'manual',
  noFile: (looked: string) =>
    `No tasks file (looked for ${looked}). Name one above, or write one: one checklist line per task, "- [ ] T-1 Title (after T-0)", indented lines for its brief.`,
  fileLabel: 'Tasks file',
  draft: (path: string) => `✎ Have Claude write ${path}`,
  drafting: (path: string) => `✎ Claude writes ${path} from the repository and this conversation; the pane reads it once it is there.`,
  noSession: 'No session on the radar: open one with radar loaded, it shows up here once idle.',
  noneAvailable: 'No session takes tasks: type /radar available in one, or press ⛑ Take tasks in its radar pane.',
  working: 'working',
  question: 'question',
  blocked: 'blocked',
  delivered: 'delivered',
  free: 'free:',
  queue: 'queue:',
  waitsOn: (ids: string) => `waits on ${ids}:`,
  answerPlaceholder: 'Your answer…',
  answerLabel: (name: string) => `↩ Answer ${name}`,
  give: (id: string, name: string) => `⇢ ${id} → ${name}`,
  requeue: (id: string) => `↺ Requeue ${id}`,
  startAuto: '▶ Auto',
  pauseAuto: '⏸ Pause',
  reload: '↻ Reload',
  human: 'yours (👤):',
  open: '⛑ Conductor',
  opened: 'Conductor opened.',
  sentTo: (id: string, name: string) => `⇢ ${id} sent to ${name}`,
  notSent: (id: string, name: string, why: string) => `⇢ ${id} not sent to ${name}: ${why}`,
  reported: (id: string, name: string, status: string, note: string) => `${name} · ${id} ${status}${note ? `: ${note}` : ''}`,
  answered: (id: string, name: string) => `↩ answer to ${name} on ${id} sent`,
  noWorktree: (id: string, why: string) => `⇢ ${id} not sent: its worktree could not be made (${why})`,
}

export type ConductorTexts = typeof CONDUCTOR_EN

export const CONDUCTOR_FR: Partial<ConductorTexts> = {
  title: '⛑ Chef de chantier',
  tasks: n => (n === 1 ? '1 tâche' : `${n} tâches`),
  auto: 'auto',
  manual: 'manuel',
  noFile: looked =>
    `Pas de fichier de tâches (cherché : ${looked}). Nommez-en un ci-dessus, ou écrivez-le : une case à cocher par tâche, « - [ ] T-1 Titre (after T-0) », les lignes en retrait pour sa consigne.`,
  fileLabel: 'Fichier de tâches',
  draft: path => `✎ Faire écrire ${path} par Claude`,
  drafting: path => `✎ Claude écrit ${path} d’après le dépôt et cette conversation ; le pane le lira dès qu’il existe.`,
  noSession: 'Aucune session sur le radar : ouvrez-en une avec radar chargé, elle apparaît ici dès qu’elle est inactive.',
  noneAvailable: 'Aucune session n’accepte de tâches : tapez /radar available dans l’une d’elles, ou ⛑ Accepter des tâches dans son pane radar.',
  working: 'en cours',
  question: 'question',
  blocked: 'bloquée',
  delivered: 'livrée',
  free: 'libres :',
  queue: 'file :',
  waitsOn: ids => `attend ${ids} :`,
  answerPlaceholder: 'Votre réponse…',
  answerLabel: name => `↩ Répondre à ${name}`,
  requeue: id => `↺ Remettre ${id} en file`,
  startAuto: '▶ Auto',
  pauseAuto: '⏸ Geler',
  reload: '↻ Relire',
  human: 'à vous (👤) :',
  open: '⛑ Chef de chantier',
  opened: 'Chef de chantier ouvert.',
  sentTo: (id, name) => `⇢ ${id} confiée à ${name}`,
  notSent: (id, name, why) => `⇢ ${id} non envoyée à ${name} : ${why}`,
  answered: (id, name) => `↩ réponse envoyée à ${name} sur ${id}`,
  noWorktree: (id, why) => `⇢ ${id} non envoyée : son worktree n’a pas pu être créé (${why})`,
}

/** Every word the mod says: the radar's, and the conductor's under `c`. */
export type Said = Texts & { c: ConductorTexts }

/** The bundle a `language` option names; anything but `fr` is English. */
export function sayOf(language: unknown): Said {
  return String(language ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'fr'
    ? { ...EN, ...FR, c: { ...CONDUCTOR_EN, ...CONDUCTOR_FR } }
    : { ...EN, c: CONDUCTOR_EN }
}
